_comment: Shared scan-normalization vectors (S1 backend, S2 frontend). 'piece' = ScanInputNormalizer.normalizePiece(input). 'tracking' = TrackingNumberNormalizer.normalize(input) (null = rejected); a vector without 'tracking' does not assert it.
